ITEM 1 | Toasted bagel-style half with golden-brown crust and pale, lightly textured crumb, topped with a thick smear of off-white, creamy spread covering most of the cut face, slightly glossy and soft, sitting on a white rectangular plate; approx. 9 cm wide by 7 cm deep, about 2 cm tall | 85
ITEM 2 | Toasted bagel-style half with golden-brown browned crust edges and pale crumb, topped with a smaller mound of off-white creamy spread in the center-right, soft and smooth, approx. 9 cm by 7 cm, about 2 cm tall, next to the other half | 70
ITEM 3 | Cream-colored spread, soft and spreadable, applied to both bagel halves, with a dollop of the same off-white spread on the lower half, matte to slightly glossy texture, sitting on the bread surfaces | 30
ITEM 4 | Thin rounds of cucumber, bright green skin with pale green flesh, cut in slices about 0.3 cm thick, slightly overlapping in a small stack, moist and firm, approx. 5 cm across, sitting at the upper left of the plate | 15
ITEM 5 | Pale yellow-cream cheese stick or block, firm, smooth surface with slight sheen, rectangular cylinder about 7 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, lying along the lower edge of the plate below the bread | 25
